title: In November 2025 the Constitutional Court confirmed that Aceh's special rules and national law run together — kekhususan is not a separate jurisdiction.
sourceLine: Source: Mahkamah Konstitusi, Putusan 140/PUU-XXIII/2025, 13 Nov 2025; MKRI press release, 13 Nov 2025. [114][115]
